definitions.rationale: Macro equation expanding digitSumLoopBody into the exact two-statement loop body; it names syntax and adds no execution or mathematical fact.
definitions.text:
rule digitSumLoopBody =>
      AugAssign(Name("total"), "+",
        BinOp("%", Name("number"), Int(10)))
      AugAssign(Name("number"), "//", Int(10))

definitions.rationale: Macro equation expanding digitSumBody into the exact helper-function statements, including the named loop-body macro.
definitions.text:
rule digitSumBody =>
      If(Compare(Name("number"), CmpOp("<", Int(0))),
        Assign(Name("sign"), UnaryOp("-", Int(1)))
        Assign(Name("number"), UnaryOp("-", Name("number"))),
        Assign(Name("sign"), Int(1)))
      Assign(Name("total"), Int(0))
      While(Compare(Name("number"), CmpOp(">=", Int(10))),
        digitSumLoopBody)
      Return(BinOp("+", Name("total"),
        BinOp("*", Name("sign"), Name("number"))))

definitions.rationale: Macro equation expanding orderByPointsBody into the exact return statement that invokes sorted with digit_sum as its key.
definitions.text:
rule orderByPointsBody =>
      Return(Call(Name("sorted"), Name("nums"),
        KwArg("key", Name("digit_sum"))))

definitions.rationale: Macro equation defining solutionModule as the two exact function definitions used by the proof.
definitions.text:
rule solutionModule =>
      Module(
        FuncDef("digit_sum", Params("number"), digitSumBody)
        FuncDef("order_by_points", Params("nums"), orderByPointsBody))

definitions.rationale: Nonnegative branch of the total magnitude function, defining magnitude(N) as N when N is nonnegative.
definitions.text:
rule magnitude(N:Int) => N
    requires N >=Int 0

definitions.rationale: Negative branch of the total magnitude function, defining magnitude(N) by integer negation when N is negative.
definitions.text:
rule magnitude(N:Int) => 0 -Int N
    requires N <Int 0

definitions.rationale: Base equation for leadingDigit on a nonnegative single-digit integer.
definitions.text:
rule leadingDigit(N:Int) => N
    requires 0 <=Int N andBool N <Int 10

definitions.rationale: Recursive equation defining leadingDigit for integers at least 10 by removing the low decimal digit.
definitions.text:
rule leadingDigit(N:Int)
    => leadingDigit((N -Int pyMod(N, 10)) /Int 10)
    requires N >=Int 10

definitions.rationale: Sign-normalization equation completing the total definition of leadingDigit on negative integers.
definitions.text:
rule leadingDigit(N:Int) => leadingDigit(0 -Int N)
    requires N <Int 0

definitions.rationale: Nonnegative wrapper equation defining lowerDigitSum through lowerDigitSumAcc with initial accumulator zero.
definitions.text:
rule lowerDigitSum(N:Int) => lowerDigitSumAcc(N, 0)
    requires N >=Int 0

definitions.rationale: Negative wrapper equation defining lowerDigitSum after normalizing the argument's sign and initializing the accumulator.
definitions.text:
rule lowerDigitSum(N:Int) => lowerDigitSumAcc(0 -Int N, 0)
    requires N <Int 0

definitions.rationale: Base equation for the lowerDigitSumAcc recurrence, returning the accumulator once only the leading digit remains.
definitions.text:
rule lowerDigitSumAcc(N:Int, S:Int) => S
    requires 0 <=Int N andBool N <Int 10

definitions.rationale: Recursive accumulator equation defining how the low decimal digit is added before recurring on the quotient.
definitions.text:
rule lowerDigitSumAcc(N:Int, S:Int)
    => lowerDigitSumAcc(
         (N -Int pyMod(N, 10)) /Int 10,
         S +Int pyMod(N, 10))
    requires N >=Int 10

definitions.rationale: Sign-normalization equation completing the total lowerDigitSumAcc definition for negative first arguments.
definitions.text:
rule lowerDigitSumAcc(N:Int, S:Int)
    => lowerDigitSumAcc(0 -Int N, S)
    requires N <Int 0

definitions.rationale: Nonnegative branch defining signedDigitSum as the lower-digit sum plus the leading digit.
definitions.text:
rule signedDigitSum(N:Int)
    => lowerDigitSum(magnitude(N)) +Int leadingDigit(magnitude(N))
    requires N >=Int 0

definitions.rationale: Negative branch defining signedDigitSum as the lower-digit sum minus the leading digit, matching the prompt's signed-leading-digit convention.
definitions.text:
rule signedDigitSum(N:Int)
    => lowerDigitSum(magnitude(N)) -Int leadingDigit(magnitude(N))
    requires N <Int 0

definitions.rationale: Base equation defining the structural allInts predicate as true on the empty value sequence.
definitions.text: rule allInts(.ValSeq) => true

definitions.rationale: Recursive equation defining allInts on an integer-headed sequence by checking the remaining sequence.
definitions.text: rule allInts(vCons(_:Int, REST:ValSeq)) => allInts(REST)

definitions.rationale: Guarded rejection equation completing the structural allInts definition for a non-integer head.
definitions.text:
rule allInts(vCons(V:Val, _:ValSeq)) => false
    requires notBool isInt(V)

definitions.rationale: Unconditional equation defining the named proof term expectedOrder as the supplied opaque sortKeyVS applied to the exact digit_sum closure; it asserts no separate ordering lemma.
definitions.text:
rule expectedOrder(VS:ValSeq)
    => sortKeyVS(
         VS,
         closureVal("number", digitSumBody, 0))
